what: When an uppercase title touches the 10% line from the bottom of the screen, each letter sits outside 2.5 letter-widths to the left of its place, tilted 45° and stretched 6x horizontally (pivoting on its right edge), then folds into place in .3s power2.out — with .015s between letters, they snap in one after another from the left in an instant. Each letter has a mask so it isn’t visible outside its cell. Once only

options.x: Start position (% of text width), default -250
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default top bottom-=10% (original large title is top bottom-=5%)
options.mask: If none, the text mask is not applied (default applied)

note: The original splits text only at 800px and up — on phones the text stays as is. The original mask has 15px of room above and below (padding-block 15px · margin-block -15px) so stretched letters aren’t clipped at the top and bottom

from.where: Large headings on all pages (DISPLAY·H1·H2) data-split=fly — original wf effect-12: SplitText chars,words mask chars, from xPercent -250·rotationZ 45·scaleX 6·origin 100% 50% → .3s power2.out stagger .015, start top bottom-=10%(DISPLAY -5%)
